Container.Name: PassGate
Container.Overview: Sell Wi-Fi passes with Stripe. A self-hosted captive portal for campgrounds, lakes, cabins, RV parks and marinas: guests join your open Wi-Fi, pick a day, weekend or monthly pass, pay by card and are online right away. Works with any access points; the firewall side uses OPNsense.[br][br] [b]Trying it out:[/b] the defaults run on the normal bridge network in dry-run mode. Open the WebUI, finish the setup wizard, and click through the guest pages on the portal port.[br][br] [b]For real use:[/b] set Network Type to your services VLAN (e.g. br0.51) with a fixed IP (e.g. 10.51.0.2). The port settings are then ignored (the portal listens on 80 and 443, the admin page on 8081). See the network guide in the project's docs.
Container.Requires: OPNsense (as a VM or separate box) for the firewall side. Not needed for trying it out.

Config.Name: Guest portal port
Config.Description: Port for the guest sign-in pages (bridge mode only).

Config.Name: Guest portal HTTPS port
Config.Description: HTTPS for the guest pages, once a certificate is set up in the admin's HTTPS page (bridge mode only).

Config.Name: Admin port
Config.Description: Port for the owner dashboard (bridge mode only). Never expose this to guests.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and plans. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. America/Toronto. The setup wizard also detects it from your browser.
